verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an entitlements system that grants customers features based on the products they subscribe to, managed through a Features UI and draftable alongside plans by Chargebee AI. That covers the modeling half of the story. The pack also shows a general REST API and official SDKs, but no cited item describes an entitlements resource or endpoint for checking a customer's entitlements at runtime. Missing for 10: explicit API/SDK endpoint for runtime entitlement checks, documentation of limit/quantity-type entitlements, independent or hands-on corroboration.
